response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years of experience, but the profile is overwhelmingly web/full-stack (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than modern C++. His hands-on C++ work is limited to a brief 7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a bachelor thesis project. He shows no evidence of MQTT, message brokers in industrial contexts, IEC 62443/SDL practices, or industrial-automation protocols, which are core requirements for this role.
strengths: Deep systems experience with low-latency, high-throughput services (async I/O, fibers, caching in DLang)
Strong software craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions
Broad polyglot background with distributed and event-driven architecture exposure (GISCollective platform)
concerns: Very limited and outdated C++ experience (~7 months in 2014–2015), the core skill of the role
No industrial cybersecurity, IEC 62443, SDL, or automation protocol experience (Modbus, OPC UA, MQTT)
Career trajectory is focused on web/full-stack and AI tooling, suggesting misalignment with an industrial C++ role
